about_the_game:
Infinity Rage – The hellish pinball-brickbreaking arcade nightmare

Infinity Rage is a unique blend of classic pinball and the legendary Breakout game. You’re hitting the ball with flippers, breaking bricks but there’s a twist:
👉 you have infinite balls, but one mistake resets everything.

Your goal is simple:
🎯 Collect all 45 badges if you can!

🔥 Key features

  • No hole to lose your ball instead, a deadly spike awaits. Hit it and your score resets.

  • Timed gameplay your final score depends on how fast and smart you play.

  • 45 unique badges complete challenges and unlock all levels.

  • 12 distinct themes switch anytime.

  • Sarcastic commentary the game mocks you loudly every time you fail.

  • Online leaderboard prove your skill to the world.

  • Create your own themes customize visuals, music, SFX, and even the demon’s voice lines.

🎨 Make your own levels and become part of the game!

If you love creativity, design your own graphics and sounds!
Templates are available in the themes/#level_tools folder, and you can add custom voice lines in the say folder.

Send us your creations the best ones might be featured in the game or on the website!

Infinity Rage is about endless retries, fast restarts, and testing your patience.
If you’re persistent enough, you might conquer the ultimate challenge or just enjoy laughing along with the game as it mocks you.

HOW TO PLAY - Controls and Sensors Overview

In game
- Left Paddle Movement: "Left Shift" or "A"
- Right Paddle Movement: "Right Shift" or "L"- Pinging the Machine: "Space" You can ping three times before the machine is disabled for three seconds. After that, you can continue the game and ping three more times.

Theme Selector Buttons on the Main Screen and Between Levels

- Move Left: "Left Shift" or "A"
- Move Right: "Right Shift" or "L"
- Start Game: "Space"
